title: Future Juice Cereal & Milk  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Cereal & Milk is a classic breakfast-inspired blend that captures the familiar taste of golden, crunchy Cereal soaked in creamy Milk. The malty sweetness of toasted Cereal brings a comforting depth, while the smooth, milky undertones recreate the satisfying flavour of a fresh bowl of cereal enjoyed to the last drop. The result is a nostalgic and well-balanced vape that’s perfect for any time of day. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and rich flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a smooth and satisfying vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
